config.window_selection: shortest window containing the required cycles on all legs
config.interpretation: technical prototype settings; not physiological thresholds

assumptions: cycle start events are recording-calibrated signal hypotheses and not force-plate-validated hoof contacts
gait is supplied by the frequency-based segmentation stage and is not changed by Takt parameters
AngleZ direction is used only to keep left and right riding-line windows separate
smaller variability, absolute drift, phase dispersion and temporal symmetry deviation mean greater temporal stability, not medical soundness or a riding score
improvement and worsening are personal within-recording comparisons of disjoint windows and require a change larger than technical uncertainty

windows.interpretation_limit: descriptive temporal observations; no riding or medical score
